parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the file resource. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The ID of the owner, which is the account UID of the workspace administrator. You can log on to the Alibaba Cloud Management Console and view the account UID in the security management section of account management.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the request, used for pagination.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for this API call.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The filter condition: resource file type.

Valid values:

- Python
- Jar
- Archive
- File
